semantic_scale.0: 观察到与criterion直接矛盾的内容或行为
semantic_scale.1: 只有声明或表面线索，关键联系薄弱
semantic_scale.2: 本样本中有一个明确成立实例
semantic_scale.3: 在相关前后时刻持续成立，有至少两个证据定位
semantic_scale.4: 在声明且相关的失败、重入或等价路线仍成立，须实际观察

rules: Evaluate applicability before observation; no evidence means null, not zero.
No-character and no-control-promise routes may be not applicable with a reason.
Keep design prediction, media review, learner experience and demonstrated learning separate.
Calibrate reviewers before acceptance use; author self-review remains diagnostic.
Do not sum or average into an immersion score; two is not a validated learner cutoff.
A complete record is not proof of semantic validity, authenticated identity or learner effect.
Report actual contradictions, weak observations, missing evidence and unresolved coverage separately.
Learner and full-journey records have no expert 0-4 score.
